summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the restaurant operating-system node. The most relevant US-listed names are vertical restaurant POS/payment platforms and broader merchant-commerce platforms with restaurant-specific modules. Toast is the clearest direct pure-play above $1B market cap; Block/Square and Shift4 are scaled payment/POS platforms with restaurant/hospitality product lines; Lightspeed is NYSE-listed with restaurant POS, payments, inventory and analytics exposure; PAR is below the preferred $1B filter in the latest market snapshot but is included as a strong chokepoint-relevance exception because its restaurant software stack maps directly to POS, ordering, inventory, workforce management and enterprise restaurant data. Olo would have been a direct fit but is excluded from candidates because it ceased trading after its September 2025 acquisition by Thoma Bravo.
